resources.string: Lets the Linksy app tap, swipe and type on this phone while you control it from your computer. It does nothing when no Linksy control session is running, and it never reads your screen.

Linksy Control lets you use this phone from your computer while Linksy mirrors its screen. It only taps, swipes, presses Back or Home, and types into the field you have selected, and only while you have started control from Linksy. It has no internet access and cannot send anything anywhere.

1. Tap "Open Accessibility settings" and turn on Linksy Control.
2. On Android 13 and newer, if the switch is greyed out because you installed this app from a file, tap "Open app info", open the three-dot menu and choose "Allow restricted settings", then repeat step 1.
3. In the Linksy app, start control and approve the pairing request shown here.
If your phone does not allow this, Linksy still mirrors the screen and can type through the Linksy keyboard.
Pairing is disabled. This build has no official Linksy certificate configured, so no app can control the phone. Install an official build.
Pairing is available for the official Linksy app only.
Allow Linksy to control this phone?
The Linksy app (%1$s, verified by its signature) wants to tap, swipe and type on this phone while you control it from your computer. You can revoke this any time in Linksy Control.
This request was not accepted: it does not come from the official Linksy app, or pairing is not configured in this build.
